Setup, value equality, liveness checks, serialization, digest/replay, and both Gc.stat calls occur outside the timed CPU/wall loop. It is not an attributed collector-only CPU counter or ordinary allocation-load test.

timing_and_gc_review.untimed_collections: Eight explicit preparatory full-major calls precede first liveness. The first Gc.stat forces another collection before timing; the second forces another after timing. Before-liveness precedes the first stat; after-liveness/live_words follow the second stat. The stat-to-stat forced delta is25, while timed quick-stat count delta is24. These are stabilized outside-timer gauges, not exact timer-edge liveness snapshots.
